Create a polished, technically exact architecture overview infographic for the public GitHub README of DSH Auto Memory, version 3.2.10. Landscape 1536x1024 or larger, crisp flat vector-like infographic raster, white/light warm background, restrained teal/navy/amber palette, elegant thin orthogonal arrows, rounded rectangles, generous whitespace, modern developer documentation aesthetic. Tiny restrained line icons only; no mascots, photos, 3D effects, decorative flow lines, logos or watermarks. Text must remain readable when displayed at 900 px width.

Exactly 9 component boxes. Layout: a central vertical column with Memory interface (top), Plugin API & tools (second), Session memory engine (third), Memory retrieval (fourth), Semantic ranking (bottom). To the LEFT of Plugin API & tools put Session continuation. To the LEFT of Session memory engine put Memory writing. Below Memory writing, left of Memory retrieval, put Local memory files. To the RIGHT of Session memory engine put Prompt assembly. Component positions should allow clean non-crossing paths. Main central column is blue/navy; writing/file branch muted amber; prompt and continuation teal. Use consistent sized boxes with short headings, one small supporting text line.

Draw EXACTLY these 9 arrows with one clearly visible arrowhead each:
1. Memory interface -> Plugin API & tools, label "Local HTTP".
2. Plugin API & tools -> Session memory engine, label "Call".
3. Session memory engine -> Session continuation, label "Continue".
4. Session memory engine -> Prompt assembly, label "Rules / snapshot".
5. Session memory engine -> Memory writing, label "Write / consolidate".
6. Memory writing -> Local memory files, label "Write / pending".
7. Session memory engine -> Memory retrieval, label "Query".
8. Memory retrieval -> Local memory files, label "Read".
9. Memory retrieval -> Semantic ranking, label "Rank".

IMPORTANT technical meaning: Boxes other than the interface and files mostly represent modules inside the Node host, NOT separately deployed microservices. Semantic ranking may call an isolated JS inference worker or optional Python process. Local memory files include Markdown and pending USER candidates, not cloud storage. Never add a connection between Prompt assembly and Semantic ranking, nor a direct interface->file connection. No speculative future/refactor components. Session continuation groups orchestration of reserve/create/deliver, not a database. Do not add any other arrows.
